notes.title: CHOP release set to september 13th
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32162889/791244d2d89ef93dd62ed7dbb353790a64b3b763.gif[/img]

We're getting close, CHOP will get out of Early Access on [b]Friday 13th ![/b]
Icing on the cake, it's getting released on Nintendo Switch too :)
We want to say a huge thank you to those who supported us all the way from the Kickstarter campaign to this whole year of EA. We didn't expect it to be so full of obstacles, but we're really proud to never have given up. 
Be sure to be there the day after tomorrow, ready to CHOP'em all !

notes.title: Update 1.0.19
notes.notes:
Beta 1.0.19 is here, just in time for Christmas ! It brings some cool stuff, like a new game mode : Skull Hunter. 
We can now officially say that all the remaining content (tournament mode, stages, grab kills...) will be added to the game by the end of next february :)

Don't hesitate to reach us at contact@chop-thegame.com for any question or to report a bug.
Happy holidays guys !

[u] Change log : [/u]
[*]New game mode : Skull Hunter. Your goal here is to loot golden skulls on your opponents' corpses and to drop them in your portal.
[*]Skull Hunter exclusive power-up : the magnetic totem
[*]3 new stages to unlock
[*]All loading times are significantly shorter
[*]Important code optimizations
[*]Inputs icons on rebind screen for PS4 gamepad
[*][Bug Fixed] Some sounds were not paused when pressing start in game
[*][Bug Fixed] Custom setting « Start with obliterator » was only working for first spawn
[*][Bug Fixed] Player 4's special ability could be changed (i.e. possible to play Drekan with Teleport)
[*][Bug Fixed] A thrown sword could be stuck in lasers
[*][Bug Fixed] Unpluging a gamepad during a kill wasn't pausing the game
[*][Bug Fixed] Audio ducking on shields sound
[*][Bug Fixed] Power-ups illustrations not properly displayed on the settings screen
[*][Bug Fixed] Disconnecting a gamepad on victory screen was causing a softlock
[*][Bug Fixed] Pistons collisions not working properly
[*][Bug Fixed] Corner warps were not teleporting in diagonal
[*][Bug Fixed] Doing a ledge climb to the ceiling on a moving platform was reversing player's direction
[*][Bug Fixed] Teleporting when equipped with neutron capsule could make player explode
[*][Bug Fixed] Thrown swords could go through breakable or ricochet platform if thrower very close to the platform
[*][Bug Fixed] Bullets could go through some platforms if shooter very close to the platform
[*][Bug Fixed] Victory music was overlapping menu music when going back to menu
[*][Bug Fixed] In Last Survivor (2VS2), victory screen was not triggered if setting « scores on HUD » was enabled
[*][Bug Fixed] In Last Survivor : hardlock if winning team dies before the end of the sudden death
[*][Bug Fixed] On some conditions Khuno could throw 3 swords

notes.title: Update to 1.0.12
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Here comes the update to Beta 1.0.12. From now on, we'll do our best to speed things up and release updates every one or two weeks :)

[u] Patch note : [/u]
[*][Bug fixed] In Last Survivor, sometimes victory couln't be triggered, leading to endless games.
[*][Bug fixed] Lasers appearing on « Time's up » now kill players even if they're invincible
[*][Bug fixed] Victory condition setting was not reset to 5 when playing a 1VS1 game, in a different game mode than the previous game played with custom settings.
[*][Bug fixed] Victory condition setting was not reset visually when switching from custom to default settings
[*][Bug fixed] HUD score wasn't displaying negative scores in Last Survivor
[*][Bug fixed] If player died with obliterator + neutron capsule and picked up obliterator again, neutron capsule's model was still displayed on bullets
[*][Bug fixed] When chosing « Rematch » after a Last Survivor gaame (1VS1), loser was not kept in the game, forcing to go back to the main menu.
[*][Bug fixed] « AI Killer » achievements were not working properly
[*][Bug fixed] These achievements could be unlocked by AIs : Counter expert, Gunner, Beheader, Freezer, Free Hugs, Orgy, Diogenes Syndrome, Complete Loser, Sneaky bastard, Trickshot Lover, Trickshot Master, Throw Expert, Dash Expert, Call Back Expert, Teleport Expert, Telekinesis Expert, Double Sword Expert, Multikill Expert, Bomberman, Suicidal tendency.
Game can now be started with « Start button » from Stage Selec screen.

notes.title: Update to 1.0.9 and free Demo on Windows/Mac/Linux
notes.notes:
The Early Access release is coming fast now. We're really excited about it ! A bit nervous too...

Here's the list of improvements and bug fixes this update brings, for both beta and demo versions. 
And the very good news is that the [b]demo is finally available for Mac and Linux[/b] users ! Yay !

So let's give it a try, and don't forget to add the game to your wish list if you liked it ;)

[u]Changelog 1.0.9 :[/u]

[list]
[*]First loading is now significantly reduced
[*]Scoring  rules in 1 VS All changed for red player to match FFA ones
[*]New VFX for pulsating heart
[*][Bug fixed] Crash issue on Ubuntu 18.04 occuring when user pressed return key on title screen
[*][Bug fixed] Main options (music volume, graphic settings...) were not saved when quitting the game
[*][Bug fixed] In Last Survivor, game could freeze on result screens after a Sudden Death round if players killed each other.
[*][Bug fixed] In Last Survivor, HUD was displayed on loading screen even if related option was disabled
[*][Bug fixed] In Last Survivor, sometimes end of game was never triggered
[*][Bug fixed] In Last Survivor, players life count was not updated properly
[*][Bug fixed] Option to forbid Anti-gravity prism wasn't working properly
[*][Bug fixed] The achievement « Travel Agency » was not working properly
[*][Bug fixed] In team modes, games could not finish if « scores HUD » option was enabled
[*][Bug fixed] In 2VS2, P2 could kill P1 with a dash even if friendly fire was disabled
[*][Bug fixed] Invincibility time was automatically deactivated when going back to main menu and launching a new game
[*][Bug fixed] Player was never killed by spikes if he fell in it during invincibility time
[/list]

notes.title: Major update upcoming (Beta 1.0.6)
notes.notes:
Hello everyone !

We've been too quiet for some time now, but be sure this was for the best. We were working hard on a big update for the game. 

Indeed, we've just updated CHOP to Beta 1.0.6, adding a whole bunch of new features, bug fixes and gameplay improvements. Including a brand new game mode called Last Survivor, a new playable character, Steam achievements, new SFXs and remixed OST, even more game customization options, new bonuses throughout the different game modes, and it goes on and on...

Good news for Mac and Linux users : CHOP is now available on these platforms, for those who have a beta key !


[u][b]LAST SURVIVOR :[/b][/u]

No portals here. Everyone starts the game with the same amount of lives. You loose one every time you die. Once you've no lives left, you're eliminated. To win, you must have the highest kill count.
Be careful, you lose points if you accidentally commit suicide. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/94ehZqP.gif[/img]


[u][b]ASHE (The aborted experiment) :[/b][/u]

CHOP's new character Ashe enters the fray !
After a career in the military, this fierce warrior has been contaminated with a mysterious parasite. Lurking in the shadow, she now works on spreading the gruesome virus on the planet. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/awayUgF.gif[/img]


[u][b]Steam achievements :[/b][/u]

We just added 50 Steam achievements for you guys to unlock !


[u][b]New Grab Kill :[/b][/u]

This is what soccer would look like in CHOP's universe !

[img]https://i.imgur.com/4ocVdYH.gif[/img]


[u][b]New game customization and bonuses :[/b][/u]

As of now, you have the possibility to add invicibility frames when your character spawns, if you want to forbid spawn kills. 
You can also disable the auto aim, this is for the Pro Gamers...

Some new bonuses are available :
[list]
[*] Pulsating heart (Eat this raw human heart to earn an extra life - Last Survivor mode only)
[*]Adrenalin shot (A power pack to dash with no limit - All game modes)

and...

[*]Anti-Gravity Prism (An ancien artefact which reverses the arena upside down – All game modes)
[/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/o2g1WPV.gif[/img]


[u][b]Music and sound design :[/b][/u]

We were not satisfied enough with the audio of the game. Indeed, the first sound effects were made by Bastien who's really not an expert in this field ^^
So all the sounds have been reworked by our talented Sound Designer, Cédric.
Also, we thought that the musics could benefit from an extra kick. That's why Benjamin remixed the entire soundtrack, with much more emphasis on the heavy metal vibe and composed two brand new tracks !

On top of all, we've fixed a lot of bugs and improved performances across the game. Oh, and we've added French translation.


[u]General[/u]

[list]
[*]New game mode
[*]4 new arenas
[*]A new environment : the Inferno
[*]New character
[*]Each character is now bound to a specific power
[*]Stage unlock system
[*]Steam achievements
[*]New SFXs
[*]Remixed OST and new tracks
[*]French translation
[/list]

[u]Gameplay[/u]

[list]
[*]New Grab Kill
[*]3 additional bonuses
[*]Possibility to add invicibility frames on spawn
[*]Possibility to disable the sword aiming aid
[*]Possibility to disable inter-round scores screen and display score on HUD
[*]Possibility to tweak the life count that the players start the rounds with
[*]A new visual feedback on open portals so that beginners know instantly what they're meant for
[/list]

For those who don't have access to the beta yet, don't worry, an updated demo is coming in the next days, on Windows, Mac and Linux ;)
Of course this demo will have limited content compared to the beta, but will still feature :
[list]
[*]New SFXs
[*]Remixed OST
[*]French translation
[*]Possibility to add invicibility frames on spawn
[*]Possibility to disable the sword aiming aid
[*]Possibility to disable inter-round scores screen and display score on HUD
[/list]

To keep up to date on the latest news, be sure to sign up to our official mailing list :
http://chop-thegame.com

Have a good one and see you in the next update !
